meta.modeNote: 2026 results come from the CEC results file by locality supplied by the project owner on 31 Oct 2026 (expc.csv): all ballot boxes counted, 7,331,981 eligible, 5,716,673 votes incl. 451,988 double envelopes (78.0%). Results are not yet certified as final. Earlier builds used the 22:00 election-day turnout report; it is kept in data/raw/2026/ for reference but no longer used. When certified results are published, replace data/raw/2026/expc.csv, set mode to "official_final" and run `npm run build:data`.

meta.turnoutDefinition: Turnout = voters ÷ eligible voters × 100, per the CEC: 'voters' (מצביעים) are envelopes cast at the locality's ballot boxes (valid + invalid); 'eligible' (בזב) are registered voters assigned to those boxes. Double-envelope votes (soldiers, diplomats, prisoners, hospital patients, etc.; CEC code 9999) are counted centrally and not attributed to any locality, so locality turnout is lower than the national turnout. The same definition is used for both elections. turnout_change_pp = turnout_2026_pct − turnout_2022_pct.
